name: Benchmark suite based on International Planning Competition domains
description: A benchmark suite developed to systematically evaluate the planning capabilities of large language models in commonsense planning tasks, including autonomous plan generation, heuristic guidance, and human-in-the-loop modes. It is based on domains from the International Planning Competition and includes evaluation tools to support research.
reputation: A niche planning benchmark suite used in research on LLM-based planning, but not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on evaluating LLM planning abilities in autonomous, heuristic, and human-in-the-loop modes.
